script: Stop texting her, "How are you?" It sounds exactly like every other message she got today, so she replies with a cold "Good." "You?" It didn't die because she's complicated, it died because you sound like everyone else. Stay until the last one. Tell her, "I came to a conclusion about you, but I need to check if I'm wrong." Then don't explain. Curiosity pulls her in. Break the pattern. Say the boldest opinion, are you the kind of person who makes life complicated, or more interesting? Tell her, "There's something curious about people like you, but first I need to check if my theory is right." Nothing more. Don't explain everything too fast. Leave her space to discover more. Comment the word OPENER, and I'll send you my free playbook.
